title: SEAF MC Modpack
description: The Official Modpack for the SEAF MC Minecraft Server.
body:
## General Info
This pack exists to give the players of the SEAF MC minecraft server a more closely integrated experience with the unique mechanics of the server.
While it is possible to use this on other servers we would not recommend it. As this pack contains specific mods that may trigger non-vanilla anti-cheat systems.

## The Focus
This pack, much like the server it was made for, has a strong focus on the Vanilla+ theme. You can expect an optifine like experience with tons of QOL features sprinkled throughout every corner of the game.

## Updates
We try to update this pack as soon as possible after major Minecraft updates. You can also expect occasional mini updates to maintain parity with Fabulously Optimized.

## Credits
1. Based off the [Fabulously Optimized](https://download.fo/) modpack.
2. Thank you to the amazing developers of the included mods.
3. Developed and maintained by the SEAF MC server staff.
